rules.description: useMutation must declare all three generics: <ResponseType, ErrorType, VariablesType>
Every mutation must have explicit error handling via onError or typed error generic
onSuccess must call invalidateQueries or setQueryData to keep cache consistent
Do not call setState inside onSuccess — use query cache for derived state
Mutation variables must have explicit TypeScript types (no implicit any payload)
If onMutate is used for optimistic updates, onError must restore previous state via context
Hook name must end with 'Mutation' for clear intent (e.g., useUpdateUserMutation)
